id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Multi-drop 2-wire bus; all devices share SDA and SCL through wired-AND open-drain (or push-pull in UFm).

supported_topologies.name: Single master + single slave
supported_topologies.description: Two devices sharing SDA + SCL with one set of pull-up resistors.

supported_topologies.name: Single master + multi-slave
supported_topologies.description: One master + N slaves; each slave addressed by unique 7-bit or 10-bit address. ~112 free 7-bit addresses available.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-master + multi-slave
supported_topologies.description: Multiple masters share the same bus. Bus access is arbitrated bit-by-bit on SDA while SCL HIGH.

supported_topologies.name: Hub / repeater / extender
supported_topologies.description: Boosts bus capacitance budget or reach via dedicated I2C hub ICs.

supported_topologies.name: Multiplexer / switch
supported_topologies.description: Allows segmenting the bus into multiple branches with independent capacitance.

supported_topologies.name: Bridge
supported_topologies.description: Translates between I2C and other interfaces (SPI, UART, USB).

responsibilities: Generate SCL clock pulses (all 9 per byte)
Send 7-bit (or 10-bit) slave address byte + R/W bit
In multi-master systems: participate in arbitration
Match its address against received address byte
Drive (read) or sample (write) SDA per R/W direction

master_slave_role_summary.description: Drives SDA during the 8 data bits of a byte. May be master (in master-write) or slave (in master-read).
Samples SDA on rising SCL; drives ACK / NACK on 9th pulse. May be master or slave.

ultra_fast_mode_topology.description: Push-pull, unidirectional master-to-slaves only. No arbitration, no clock stretching, no ACK.
ultra_fast_mode_topology.use_case: LED controllers, GPO devices that need fast unidirectional writes.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no central protocol-layer interconnect — the bus is a flat multi-drop shared medium. The 'interconnect' is purely physical (wires + pull-ups + hubs/repeaters).

ordering_guarantees.within_a_transaction: Bytes are transmitted in software-issue order, MSB-first within each byte.
ordering_guarantees.across_transactions: No fairness guarantee in multi-master; arbitration determines who completes first.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable — I2C is a wire-level protocol, not a memory bus. Per-device register maps are defined by the individual device datasheets, not by UM10204.

slave_classification.addressable_slave: Standard slave with hardwired or pin-selectable 7/10-bit address.
slave_classification.general_call_slave: Slave that recognizes the General Call address (0x00, R/W=0) in addition to its own.
slave_classification.ufm_slave: Ultra Fast-mode receive-only slave (LED controller, GPO).
